capabilities.reason: Worker result usage is available, but author, planner, repo-map, review, follow-up, and semantic invocations are not yet completely attributed.
No common runner executes single_codex, agentteam_direct, and agentteam_full from one immutable manifest.
P0-A defines and validates the minimal manifest contract, but retained manifest publication and execution are deferred to P0-B.
Attempt worktrees exist, but experiment-level clean reset and enforced gold-patch denial are not implemented.
Timeouts, retry limits, and round limits exist, but equal token and wall-time experiment budgets with resumable safe-boundary stops do not.
Operator events exist, but expected actions, corrective interventions, and decision escalations are not normalized into an experiment ledger.
Events, reports, and rebuildable projections exist, but no immutable experiment result bundle reconciles acceptance, usage, time, attempts, interventions, and artifact bytes.
